name: Oshiete ♪ Futaba Sensei Lesson 1 Toujou! Futaba Sensei
original_name: おしえてっ♪ふたば先生レッスン１登場！ふたば先生
source:
Futaba sensei is near-sighted and can't give proper tutorship lessons without glasses. But when she puts these glasses on, she starts to misunderstood everything as erotic!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
